from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BASE = ROOT / 'build/format-ordinal'
SOURCE = Path('/Users/h2o/dev/duxcel/tests/downloads/yellow_tripdata_2025-01.parquet')
STAMP = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
OUT = BASE / STAMP
OUT.mkdir(parents=True)
def digest(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as file:
        while block := file.read(65536):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
def stat(path):
    s = path.stat()
    return dict(bytes=s.st_size, inode=s.st_ino, device=s.st_dev, mtime_ns=s.st_mtime_ns)
before, source_sha = stat(SOURCE), digest(SOURCE)
order, raw = [], {}
started = time.monotonic()
def execute(case, variant):
    name = f'{case}-{variant}'
    target = OUT / f'{name}.json'
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='spill-', dir=OUT) as temp:
        command = [str(BASE / 'benchmark'), str(case), str(variant), str(SOURCE), temp, str(target)]
        begin = time.monotonic()
        result = subprocess.run(command, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        duration = time.monotonic() - begin
    if result.returncode:
        (OUT / f'{name}.failure.txt').write_text(result.stdout + result.stderr)
        raise RuntimeError(f'{name}: {result.returncode}: {result.stderr}')
    value = json.loads(target.read_text())
    value['process_seconds'] = duration
    order.append(name)
    print(f'{name}: ' + (f"inspection {value['elapsed_ms']:.3f} ms" if case == 'inspect' else f"cold {value['runs'][0]['query_ms']:.3f} ms, warm median {statistics.median(run['query_ms'] for run in value['runs'][1:]):.3f} ms"), flush=True)
    return value
inspection = execute('inspect', 0)
for case in range(6):
    for step in range(3):
        variant = (case + step) % 3
        raw[(case, variant)] = execute(case, variant)
assert stat(SOURCE) == before and digest(SOURCE) == source_sha, 'read-only source changed'
validation, records = [], []
for case in range(6):
    reference = raw[(case, 0)]
    for variant in range(3):
        entry = raw[(case, variant)]
        assert entry['business_schema'] == reference['business_schema']
        assert entry['business_rows'] == reference['business_rows'], f'business values differ: {case}/{variant}'
        assert len(entry['business_rows']) == 256
        assert len(entry['business_rows'][0]) == entry['visible_columns'] == 20
        assert entry['transport_columns'] == 20 + bool(variant)
        if variant:
            ids = [int(value) for value in entry['record_ids']]
            assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)) == 256
            assert entry['record_ids'] == raw[(case, 1 if variant == 2 else 2)]['record_ids'], f'ordinal source differs: {case}'
        timings = [run['query_ms'] for run in entry['runs'][1:]]
        baseline = statistics.median(run['query_ms'] for run in reference['runs'][1:])
        record = {key: value for key, value in entry.items() if key not in ['business_rows', 'record_ids', 'explain']}
        record['warm_median_ms'] = statistics.median(timings)
        record['warm_min_ms'] = min(timings)
        record['warm_max_ms'] = max(timings)
        record['warm_ratio_to_business_only'] = record['warm_median_ms'] / baseline
        record['business_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(entry['business_rows'], ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()
        record['ids_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(entry['record_ids'], separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest() if variant else None
        record['first_id'] = entry['record_ids'][0] if variant else None
        record['last_id'] = entry['record_ids'][-1] if variant else None
        if case in [1, 3]:
            record['explain'] = entry['explain']
        records.append(record)
    validation.append(dict(case=reference['case'], exact_business_schema_values_equal=True, all_rows=256,
        unique_original_ids=True, window_ids_equal_normalized_file_metadata=True, hidden_identity_excluded_from_20_business_fields=True))
summary = dict(schema='duxcel.source-format-ordinal-feasibility', version=1, timestamp_utc=STAMP,
    scope='Standalone native C/DuckDB experiment only; no App/source-format implementation, GUI, browser, schema or production-source changes.',
    revision=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
    source=dict(path=str(SOURCE), sha256=source_sha, **before),
    host=dict(system=platform.platform(), machine=platform.machine(), cpu_count=os.cpu_count(), python=platform.python_version()),
    reproduction=dict(compile='cc -std=c99 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -I/opt/homebrew/opt/duckdb/include build/format-ordinal/benchmark.c -L/opt/homebrew/opt/duckdb/lib -Wl,-rpath,/opt/homebrew/opt/duckdb/lib -lduckdb -o build/format-ordinal/benchmark',
        run='python3 build/format-ordinal/run.py',
        compiler=subprocess.check_output(['cc', '--version'], text=True).splitlines()[0],
        harness_sha256=digest(BASE / 'benchmark.c'), binary_sha256=digest(BASE / 'benchmark'),
        library_sha256=digest(Path('/opt/homebrew/opt/duckdb/lib/libduckdb.dylib')),
        harness_source=(BASE / 'benchmark.c').read_text(), runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    method=dict(measurement_sessions=18, fresh_database_per_session=True, warm_repetitions=5,
        timed_queries=108, total_explicit_queries=165, row_limit=256, order=order,
        cold='First timed data query in fresh private in-memory DB after LIMIT0 schema and settings query. OS page cache is uncontrolled and previously used. Not cold disk/startup latency.',
        timing='CLOCK_MONOTONIC around synchronous duckdb_query, including parse/bind/execute/materialization. Exact value conversion/validation is outside query_ms. Separate conversion timing performs TWO complete digest conversions, not App Page latency.',
        rss='Per-child getrusage ru_maxrss bytes on macOS; cumulative across six measured queries and EXPLAIN. Mach resident_size samples immediately before/after each timed query. Not engine-only allocation or per-query peak.',
        concurrency='One child/compiler/engine at a time in this worktree. Integration owner authorized one other compiler/native-engine lane; host CPU/I/O contention is not excluded.',
        sort='All twenty business fields determine order; ordinal variants add internal ID as final tie-breaker. Exact duplicate business rows stay comparable to baseline.',
        projection='Ordinal remains selected in engine result, so optimizer cannot prune the window. C separates final metadata column and verifies business-only projection/schema.',
        external_file_cache='Default engine setting retained and recorded; warm queries can reuse it.',
        private_storage='Fresh private per-process spill directory under ignored worktree build; deleted after each child. Source opened read-only by read_parquet.'),
    inspection=inspection, validations=validation, measurements=records,
    elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started, raw_artifacts=str(OUT),
    limits=['One 56MiB local Parquet and installed native DuckDB only; no CSV, multiple files, custom query, aggregate, browser, production App or ASan acceptance.',
        'Cold is engine-session cold, not cold filesystem cache. Per-process RSS includes DuckDB/library/allocator baseline.',
        'Identity checks prove this immutable input and these ordering/filter shapes; they do not establish cross-refresh logical identity or choose an architecture. All plan limits remain proposed.'])
(OUT / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
(BASE / 'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(directory=str(OUT), summary=str(OUT / 'summary.json')), indent=2) + '\n')
print(f"PASS: {len(validation)} case families, 18 private measurement sessions, 108 timed queries; {summary['elapsed_seconds']:.3f} s. {OUT / 'summary.json'}", flush=True)

method.cold: First timed data query in fresh private in-memory DB after LIMIT0 schema and settings query. OS page cache is uncontrolled and previously used. Not cold disk/startup latency.
method.timing: CLOCK_MONOTONIC around synchronous duckdb_query, including parse/bind/execute/materialization. Exact value conversion/validation is outside query_ms. Separate conversion timing performs TWO complete digest conversions, not App Page latency.
method.rss: Per-child getrusage ru_maxrss bytes on macOS; cumulative across six measured queries and EXPLAIN. Mach resident_size samples immediately before/after each timed query. Not engine-only allocation or per-query peak.
method.concurrency: One child/compiler/engine at a time in this worktree. Integration owner authorized one other compiler/native-engine lane; host CPU/I/O contention is not excluded.
method.sort: All twenty business fields determine order; ordinal variants add internal ID as final tie-breaker. Exact duplicate business rows stay comparable to baseline.
method.projection: Ordinal remains selected in engine result, so optimizer cannot prune the window. C separates final metadata column and verifies business-only projection/schema.
method.external_file_cache: Default engine setting retained and recorded; warm queries can reuse it.
method.private_storage: Fresh private per-process spill directory under ignored worktree build; deleted after each child. Source opened read-only by read_parquet.

limits: One 56MiB local Parquet and installed native DuckDB only; no CSV, multiple files, custom query, aggregate, browser, production App or ASan acceptance.
Cold is engine-session cold, not cold filesystem cache. Per-process RSS includes DuckDB/library/allocator baseline.
Identity checks prove this immutable input and these ordering/filter shapes; they do not establish cross-refresh logical identity or choose an architecture. All plan limits remain proposed.

interpretation.scan_filters: Both retained baseline and file_row_number EXPLAIN plans put the date predicate in READ_PARQUET. The row_number plan puts FILTER above STREAMING_WINDOW, with no scan predicate.
interpretation.feasibility: Do not adopt a uniform pre-filter window for Parquet based on first-page success. file_row_number is a supported measured candidate for this single-file native source, pending integration and compatibility gates. No architecture is committed.
interpretation.cold_sort_caveat: One fresh sorted-first metadata sample was 383.659 ms versus 276.349 ms baseline; corresponding five-run warm medians were 286.137 ms versus 273.758 ms. Near-baseline warm results are not universal cold-cost parity.
